$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows (editors use it); ignored.

project.description: The project's name or id; the CLI's --project wins.

defaults.description: Settings every model starts from (see Model defaults).

title: ssg.models.json
description: Declares the 3D models a game keeps in a folder: `slop build` exports each one as a GLB plus a `.model.json` manifest, downloads only what changed, removes files of models no longer declared and indexes them in `models.json`. A bare list of models works too.

asset.description: Asset id, or name ("SM_Veh_Pickup_Lift_01", or "Pack/Name" when several packs have it). Not with a built kind.

trackpiece.description: A procedural track piece instead of an asset (see Track piece).

terrain.description: Terrain on the track grid instead of an asset (see Terrain (3D)).

skydome.description: A skydome instead of an asset (see Skydome).

composite.description: One model from several assets at offsets (see Composite).

collider.description: The collider the export carries (CS-FB-002): box (the manifest's box; default for assets), trimesh (also a collider node in the GLB; default for track pieces) or convex (assets: the hull of the visual mesh).

colliderExclude.description: Parts a trimesh or convex collider leaves out, by role (wheel, door…) or part name. Default the moving parts; [] keeps every part.

convexMaxVertices.description: With collider convex: the most vertices the hull may have (default 255, what physics engines take).

name.description: Output name (file names and the GLB's root node). Default: the asset's name.

clips.description: Clips baked into the GLB (characters only): a clip name, name@Masculine|Feminine|Neutral, name@Polygon|Sidekick (the rig family), name@<pack>, or an animation id.

inPlace.description: In-place clips (default true); false keeps the root motion.

attach.description: Extra pieces: bundled attachments of the same file by mesh name, or other attachment assets by name or id.

replaceWheels.description: When an attachment brings four road wheels of its own (a lift kit), the model's own are dropped and the attachment's become the wheels (default true).

origin.description: Where the model's origin goes: the centre of its bottom (default), the centre of the wheel axles at axle height (vehicles), or the source model's own origin.

texSize.description: Largest texture side in pixels (scaled down to fit, never up). Default by kind: props 256, vehicles and characters 1024.

texFormat.description: Texture format: webp (default), png, or keep (as ingested).

simplify.description: Mesh simplification: the fraction of triangles to keep (0.05–1; 1 or unset = none).

tint.description: A colour (#rgb / #rrggbb): recolours the body paint. Not with variants.

variants.description: Paint variants in one GLB: [{ name, tint }] (or "red=#c62828,blue=#1e5bc6,plain"). The first is the default look.

compress.description: Geometry compression: meshopt (three.js needs MeshoptDecoder) or none (default).

fit.description: Scale the model uniformly so a dimension matches, in metres. With several, the smallest scale wins.

pose.description: Bake a character into one static mesh posed at a clip's time: { clip, time } or "Clip:0.2". Not with clips or poses.

poses.description: Several posed static meshes in one GLB, a node per pose: [{ name, clip, time }] or "idle=Idle:0,wave=Wave_01:0.2". Not with clips or pose.

splitBySwatch.description: Split the model's triangles by palette swatch (OR-FB-022): a child node swatch_<hex> per atlas colour with its own material. Static models only.

lods.description: Levels of detail in the same GLB, as falling shares of the triangles ([0.5, 0.2]); at most 4.

paint.description: The paint a tint or variants recolour (CS-FB-026): a colour #rrggbb (the swatch that is its paint) or a material name. Default: found.

decals.description: CS-FB-028: false paints over every decal and livery in the paint's texture with the paint. Default true: only small lettering enclosed by the paint.

model.title: Model
model.description: One model to export: a library asset (or a built kind: trackpiece, terrain, skydome, composite) and its options. `name` is the file name in the folder; it defaults to the asset's name.

shape.description: flat road, closed pipe (the car drives on its inside), half-pipe, or a flat road under a tunnel shell.

width.description: Drivable width between the kerbs' outer edges; for a pipe its diameter (default 10).

kerb.description: Kerb strip width on each edge, 0 for none (default 0.6).

wall.description: Wall / rail height above the deck, 0 for none (default 0.8).

thickness.description: Deck slab thickness under the surface (default 0.5).

radius.description: Half-pipe: the radius of its curved sides (default width / 4).

median.description: A divided road (CS-FB-012): the width of the central median strip (default 0: none).

medianHeight.description: The median's height (default 0.8, a concrete barrier; 0: a painted strip).

edge.description: The edge kind flat road ends report from here on (default the spec's edge, else road; e.g. highway).

track-profile.title: Track profile
track-profile.description: A track piece's cross-section: the road's shape, width, kerbs, walls and median.

turn.description: Yaw over the segment, degrees, + left.

pitch.description: Pitch over the segment, degrees, + nose up (a loop is 360).

roll.description: Rolls the path frame itself over the segment, degrees, + raises the right edge (corkscrews).

rollRadius.description: CS-FB-027: roll about an axis this many metres above the deck instead of the centre line (a barrel roll). Only with roll; no turn, pitch, shift or rise.

rollEase.description: With rollRadius: the share of the length each end takes to ease the roll in or out (0–0.5, default 0.25).

bank.description: Deck bank at the END of the segment (absolute degrees, eased from the previous end); + raises the right edge.

shift.description: Sideways offset over the segment, metres, + left, eased in and out.

rise.description: Upward offset over the segment, metres, eased (an S-shaped slope with level ends).

profile.description: This segment's profile, merged over the previous one.

blend.description: Ease from the previous segment's profile to this one over the segment (pipe-road transitions).

gap.description: No geometry: the path flies on (the gap of a jump).

track-segment.title: Track segment
track-segment.description: One segment of a custom track path: how far it goes and how it turns, pitches, rolls, banks and shifts on the way.

name.description: Socket name(s): name for its one open end, name_in / name_out when both are open.

from.description: Start where the main path is after this many segments (0: the entry). Not with start.

pos.description: A position in the piece, metres.

bank.description: The deck bank at the start.

start.description: Or start here: a position in the piece and a heading.

profile.description: Profile changes over the main path's (the profile where it starts).

open.description: Which ends are open (get sockets). Default end for from, both for start.

track-branch.title: Track branch
track-branch.description: A side path off a track piece (a pit lane, a split) with its own sockets.

preset.description: A ready-made piece; its parameters are the keys below that it takes.

footprint.description: Declared footprint in cells [across (X), along (Z)]; checked against the geometry.

elevation.description: Height of the entry above the ground (default 0; a bridge preset sets it).

bank.description: Entry bank, degrees (default 0); on a banked curve, the bank (default 30).

bankPivot.description: Bank about the edge that goes down, which stays at path height (default), or about the centre line.

path.description: A custom path of segments instead of a preset.

branches.description: Side paths with their own sockets.

materials.description: Synty swatches per slot (deck, kerb, kerbAlt, wall, support): "Pack/Asset", "Pack/Asset#rrggbb", "Pack/Material" or "#rrggbb".

spacing.description: Pillars: metres between them along the path (default 15).

size.description: Pillars: the side of their square section (default 1.6).

supports.description: Pillars or a solid fill down to y = 0 under elevated parts; auto (default) pillars where the deck is over 1.5 m up, solid for ramps.

edge.description: The edge kind a flat road end reports in its socket (default road; e.g. highway for a dual carriageway).

length.description: Cells along the piece (straight, slope, ramp, jump, corkscrew, pipe, tunnel, bridge, chicane…).

size.description: Curves and splits: the footprint in cells (1: 1×1, radius half a cell; 2: 2×2, radius 1.5 cells).

angle.description: Curves: degrees turned (default 90). Ramps / jumps: the lip angle (default 20). Helix and barrel roll: up to 1440.

radius.description: Loop: its radius in metres. Curves: the centre-line radius (instead of size). Pipe: the tube's radius. Helix: its radius. Barrel roll: the roll axis's height above the deck.

transition.description: Banked curve: the share of the arc each bank ramp takes. Slope: the share of the run each curved end takes (default 0.25).

bankIn.description: Banked curve: bank at the entry (default 0).

bankOut.description: Banked curve: bank at the exit (default 0).

from.description: Bank transition: the bank at the entry (degrees). Narrow: the wide profile at the entry ({ width, edge, median… }).

to.description: Bank transition: the bank at the exit (degrees). Widen: the wide profile at the exit.

height.description: Slopes: the rise (m); ramps / jumps: the lip height; bridges: the deck height; tunnels: the clear height; helix: the climb over its turn (negative descends).

shift.description: Loop and chicane: the sideways offset (m).

side.description: Corkscrew: the cells it moves sideways (default 1).

align.description: Loop: offset (default; the exit leaves shift metres to the side of the entry) or inline (2 cells, exit on the centre line).

turn.description: Loop: which way the exit moves (default right). Barrel roll: the wall the deck climbs first.

offset.description: Chicane: true makes it a lane change, the exit shift metres to the side of the entry (default false: an S-bend that ends in line).

travel.description: Helix: cells it advances along its entry heading while it turns (default 0).

trackpiece.title: Track piece
trackpiece.description: A procedural track piece instead of an asset (CS-FB-001): a preset with its parameters, or a path of segments swept with a profile; Synty swatch materials; sockets at its open ends.

asset.description: A Synty prop ("Pack/Asset" or a name), exported in metres and instanced.

maxSlope.description: Steepest ground it stands on, degrees (default 25).

on.description: Where: land (default, dry ground off the shore), shore (the shore only), any dry ground.

align.description: Tilt with the ground (default false: upright).

terrain-scatter.title: Terrain scatter
terrain-scatter.description: Props scattered over a terrain (cacti, rocks), instanced in the GLB.

cell.description: The grid's cell in metres (default 30, as track pieces).

height.description: One height step in metres (default 0.44 cell). Heights count steps.

tile.description: One tile: its kind (not with heights).

dir.description: The way a tile faces: slope, the uphill side N|E|S|W; corners, the uphill corner NE|NW|SE|SW; coast, the water's corner.

heights.description: A grid: corner heights in steps, rows along +Z, columns along +X: (rows + 1) × (cols + 1) numbers (not with tile).

water.description: Water per tile (rows × cols): "" or "." land, "w" water, NE | NW | SE | SW a coast; a string of one char a tile also works ("..w").

level.description: The water surface's height in metres (default 0.02).

depth.description: How far the bed under open water sinks below the surface, metres (default 1.5).

shape.description: Slope faces: planar (default; straight faces) or track (the slope-up piece's curve, so a road slope fits).

transition.description: track shape: the share of the run each curved end takes (default 0.25).

subdiv.description: Subdivisions per tile side (default 1 planar, 8 track).

skirt.description: Vertical walls this many metres down from the outer edges (default 0: none).

chunk.description: Tiles per chunk side: a grid is cut into chunk × chunk meshes (default 10).

biome.description: A swatch set: meadow (default), desert, alpine, tropical, swamp.

materials.description: Swatches per slot (ground, slope, shore, seabed, water, skirt): "Pack/Asset", "Pack/Asset#rrggbb", "Pack/Material" or "#rrggbb".

slopeAngle.description: Faces steeper than this (degrees) take the slope material (default 45).

seed.description: Seed of the shading and the scatter (default 1).

scatter.description: Props scattered over the ground (at most 8 kinds).

clear.description: Tiles [i, j] kept free of scatter (where track pieces go).

terrain3d.title: Terrain (3D)
terrain3d.description: Terrain on the track grid instead of an asset (CS-FB-003): one tile, or a whole grid of corner heights with water, coasts, swatch materials and scattered props.

preset.description: The sky and ring the colours start from.

radius.description: Dome radius, metres (default 1000; keep it inside the camera's far plane).

ground.description: Below the horizon (the far ground or sea).

ring.description: The silhouette ring's own colour before the haze.

assets.description: Synty background props by reference ("Pack/Asset"); default the preset's.

distance.description: The ring's distance as a share of the radius (default 0.85).

elevation.description: How high the tallest silhouettes reach, degrees above the horizon (default the preset's, 3–8).

haze.description: 0–1: how far the ring's colour fades into the horizon's (default 0.55).

layers.description: Rings, the far ones lower and hazier (default 2).

ring.description: The silhouette ring: true / left out for the preset's, false for none, or its settings.

panorama.description: Also an equirectangular panorama PNG of the dome and ring, this many pixels wide (default 2048; false: none).

skydome.title: Skydome
skydome.description: A skydome instead of an asset (CS-FB-004): a gradient dome and a silhouette ring of Synty background props.

name.description: Its node in the GLB (default the asset's name; repeats get _2, _3…).

rot.description: Degrees: a number turns it about +Y (yaw, + to the left); [x, y, z] are Euler angles applied X, then Y, then Z.

scale.description: A uniform scale, or [x, y, z] (default 1).

origin.description: Where the part's own origin is before it is placed: bottom-centre (default) or pivot (the source model's own origin).

attach.description: Extra pieces of this part, as a model's attach.

tint.description: Recolour this part's paint, as a model's tint.

paint.description: The paint its tint recolours, as a model's paint (#rrggbb or a material name).

decals.description: false: its decals are painted over, as a model's decals.

composite-part.title: Composite part
composite-part.description: One library asset placed in a composite model.

parts.description: The parts, each placed at its pos / rot / scale.

composite.title: Composite
composite.description: One model from several library assets at offsets (CS-FB-024): each part exported, placed and merged into one GLB with shared materials.

tint.description: #rrggbb; left out, the model's own colours.

model-variant.title: Model variant
model-variant.description: One paint variant (shared geometry, its own material and texture). The CLI form is "red=#c62828,blue=#1e5bc6,plain".

clip.description: The clip (any clips form) to pose at.

time.description: Seconds into the clip as exported (default 0).

model-pose.title: Model pose
model-pose.description: A pose to bake: a clip and a time. The CLI form is "Clip:0.2".

clip.description: The clip (any clips form) to pose at.

time.description: Seconds into the clip as exported (default 0).

model-named-pose.title: Named pose
model-named-pose.description: One of several baked poses (a node per pose in one GLB). The CLI form is "idle=Idle:0,wave=Wave_01:0.2".

footprint.description: Declared footprint in cells [across (X), along (Z)]; checked against the geometry.

elevation.description: Height of the entry above the ground (default 0; a bridge preset sets it).

bank.description: Entry bank, degrees (default 0); on a banked curve, the bank (default 30).

to.description: Bank transition: the bank at the exit (degrees). Widen: the wide profile at the exit.

shift.description: Loop and chicane: the sideways offset (m).

side.description: Corkscrew: the cells it moves sideways (default 1).

model-defaults.title: Model defaults
model-defaults.description: The `defaults` object: Model keys every model starts from (never asset or name). Asset fields do not apply to built kinds, and `trackpiece` / `terrain` here hold the fields those kinds share.
